notes.title: [GLOBAL UPDATE] VERSION 3.02.27
notes.notes:
Greetings friends, let me introduce you to the next update of our game, which consists of both improving existing aspects of the game, fixing significant bugs, and introducing new mechanics and buildings:

[list]
[*] Added a new building "Сemetery".
[*] Added return of a part of spent resources after demolition of a building.
[*] Increased resource storage limits.

[*] Fixed duplication of units after interaction with an outpost.
[*] Fixed duplication of units after returning to the base.
[*] Fixed global map interface overlapping with settlement interface.
[*] Fixed performance drop after unpausing the game.
[*] Fixed resource extraction points disappearing on the global map.
[*] Fixed settlement name reset on global map.
[*] Fixed incorrect raid map borders.

[*] Fixed ability to install a machine gun when it is not in warehouse.
[*] Fixed machine guns not working on watch towers and pillboxes.
[*] Fixed incorrect display of the number of machine guns in warehouse.
[*] Fixed bugs when building an outpost.
[*] Fixed bugs when firing units from RPG-7.
[*] Fixed a bug where a raid could not be completed.
[*] Fixed bugs related to automatic demolition of mining buildings.
[*] Fixed bugs related to research and research queue.
[*] Fixed bugs related to electricity mechanics.
[*] Fixed improving buildings without builders.
[*] Fixed the lack of a button to turn off heating in some buildings.
[*] Fixed incorrect bonuses from "Thorough search", "Commercialism" and "Steady hand" laws.
[*] Fixed incorrect loot points on the "Forest" map

[*] Fixed incorrect coal consumption by the kitchen.
[*] Fixed incorrect display of electricity consumption by buildings.
[*] Fixed incorrect display of coal consumption by Factory II.
[*] Fixed infinite game loading.
[*] Fixed minor visual bugs.
[*] Fixed minor interface bugs.

[*] Removed building coal consumption during dismantling.
[*] Removed the ability to study laws out of order.
[*] Removed the ability to produce some unexplored items.
[*] Removed the ability to re-install the stove in buildings.
[/list]
I hope you will not be disappointed with the new update and thank you for waiting so long!

notes.title: UPDATE ANNOUNCEMENT. PROBLEMS IN DEVELOPMENT.
notes.notes:
[h1] Greetings to all. [/h1]

My name is Alecksw, many of you who have followed the game before know me as a developer who has been involved in the game and technical support of the project since the beta test.

Earlier, I reported that the problems with the development of the game are directly related to the war in Ukraine, this conflict really seriously affected the pace of development and improvement of the game.

Unfortunately, things didn't work out as I planned - there were catastrophic problems in my service, the release date was set, but I didn't have time to finalize the game - I had to ask my colleagues in a hurry to fix bugs while I myself was away.

For a long period I could not work on finalizing the project, and the rest of the developers were busy with a new project of our line - Total Conflict, which turned out really well and continues to please you.

[h2]The Last Haven is still in development.[/h2]

Fortunately, I now have the conditions to work on my vacation, so soon I will try to fix critical bugs and patch up the game a little.
Please report bugs to me directly - you can always find my account in the discussions.

I will also additionally leave a comment under this post so that each of you can write to me about problems and wishes for the game. Add and write directly, please feel free to!

Friends! I am sincerely grateful to those who support the project no matter what! I really appreciate your trust and patience, thank you so much! I was forced to let down some of your expectations, however I will try to rectify the situation by any means!

During this short period, I will try to fix all critical and minor errors in order to make the project playable, until I can thoroughly work on it.

[h2]What do I plan for the future[/h2]
[list]
[*] a huge storyline with different outcomes that open after the player's decision in some situations.

[*] add new locations and a new in-game global map, including secret bunkers, use them in other plot branches.

[*] implement a separate storyline with the US army, with new models, equipment, capabilities.

[*] implement new types of buildings for other locations, new methods of resource extraction (fishing?)

[*] DLC, which will reveal new content.
[/list]
[h2]This project is very close to me, you could also feel something special in terms of atmosphere.[/h2]

[h3]All players who left negative reviews[/h3] - please send me a private message, I want to hear your opinion on the shortcomings of the game in a private dialogue! Your every vote is very important to me, but I do not always understand what exactly you wrote in the reviews of the game.

[h3]All the players who left positive feedback[/h3] - thank you, I am sincerely grateful to you for your trust, I am grateful to you and for the fact that you support the life of this project in this way and make me not give up. I appreciate you! Know that sooner or later I will definitely finish this project (I hope I can stay alive :D) and we will be able to see what we dreamed of!

[h3]To everyone who may be seeing me for the first time[/h3] - I want to assure you, I have devoted a good part of my life to this project, for me it is like a child that needs to be raised. Perhaps in this regard I am a bad father - however, I could not have done otherwise, my homeland is in danger, I think you would do the same in my place!

[h3]To everyone who hasn't left a review of our game yet[/h3] - a positive review is something you can support our entire team with (not just me, but also the part that is working on Total Conflict Resistance). Describe in it all the good, all the bad moments. Describe the emotions that the project and its idea evokes in you - I will be grateful.
We have challenged the heavy genre and we will be able to bring the matter to the end.

Join our Discord channel - https://discord.com/invite/PSmWNfCaDx


Your team
Thunder Devs

notes.title: [RELEASE] VERSION 3.02.18
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36380161/8cd7b1b7aa387f36a27d98a97680620a5fd63e28.png[/img]

The Last Haven, after two and a half years of early access, enters the current release version.

[list]
[*]Added control settings (key bindings).
[*]Added graphics and display settings.
[*]Added anti-personnel mines to the game.
[*]A system of laws has been added to the game (a new resource has been added - politics points).
[*]Research queue implemented.
[*]Added dynamite to production in factories.
[*]Added M113 armored personnel carrier.
[*]Added the ability to patrol the infantry.
[*]Added electrical system.
[*]Added research electrification, mines, M113.
[*]Added object for construction - Electric pole.
[*]Added building - Transformer.
[*]Added building - Coal Power Plant.
[*]Added building - Wind Power Generator.
[*]Added building - Gravity Accumulator.
[*]Added object for construction - Span of wires for electrification.
[*]Added an updated system of upgrades (electrical panels, the ability to install several improvements at the same time).
[*]Added economy (detailed report on all resources in the game).
[*]Added a new main menu and game settings menu.
[*]Added gamepad support.

[*]Pause fixed (when the game is unpaused, the game speed that was set by the player before the pause is restored).
[*]Fixed bugs when building walls.
[*]Fixed many small bugs.
[/list]

P.S.: You did not give up hopes, and we tried to justify them - now we are ready to present our product as a fully finished project. Thank you for your support, we deeply appreciate your trust.

notes.title: [GLOBAL UPDATE] VERSION 1.10.03
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36380161/30168f19b438884494aa1c35542571affcd383e9.png[/img]

Hello friends!
For the past few months I've been working on a global update. Due to the scale of the changes in the project, it was impossible to release updates to the game. Finally, I can show you what I was working on:

- Strategic game mode on the global map (You can attack the enemy, attack its bases, capture entire provinces, soon you will be able to create fort-posts, extract rare resources, create logistics and more!)
- 9 new locations for random battles (battles on the global map)
- New civilian transport, armored vehicle
- Customization of the player's faction (flag, army uniform, police uniform, faction name)
- New building "Headquarters"
- New building "Repair and service point" (for the repair and production of vehicles)
- New research tree (vehicle production)
- Formation and delivery of supplies for the player's mobile units (through the "Headquarters" building)
- New minimap, fix hud
- Fixed some bugs at the location "City"
- Improved interface (added icons)
- Fixed many small bugs (in AI behavior, visual errors, etc.)
- Fixed selection of units
- New transport (SUVs, armored personnel carriers)
- Ability to install a machine gun turret on an armored personnel carrier
- Improved weapon guidance system (stationary guns)
- Due to the number of changes, all old saved games are not supported.

P. S.: The strategic game mode on the global map has not been completed yet, but the main work has been done. The system of outposts has not been created (in place of the locations captured by the player). There are no minimaps on random battles. Some text is not localized (English only now). AI will be significantly improved. That's all and much more coming soon!
Weekly updates await you, there is still a lot to do. Thanks for waiting, I hope you enjoy the new gameplay elements! Do not forget to leave reviews on the game page, this will be the best reward for me!

notes.title: BETA DEV BLOG VERSION 0.10.10
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36380161/b2adf1e617a328856849e937333f2485e54084ba.jpg[/img]

- Added destructibility for all fences and walls in the game (destructible even from small arms). Over time, the number of destructible objects in the game will increase.
- Added a new mechanic for restoring (repairing) destroyed buildings in the location. Now you can populate your people in them. To do this, you need to clear the house of garbage (resources, using a resource collection point) and start the recovery process.
- Added a new type of elite opponents - Colonel Madson's Guard.
- Added Colonel Madson to the game. You can find and destroy it at the location "Military base".
- Added torture and interrogation mechanics.
- Added the ability to take enemy soldiers prisoner (To do this, you need to study the "Torture" research, build a "Propaganda Center").
- Added new locations for raids (Prison, Supply Point, Checkpoint, Food Base, Military Base, Marauder Base). These are special locations that open only after the successful completion of the interrogation of the prisoner.
- Added a new transport - an army truck M35 (crew - 8 people, soldiers are firing from vehicle), you can find it at the location "Prison" and "Military base" (locations open after a successful interrogation of a prisoner).
- Added a new type of hostages - soldiers of the US National Guard (soldiers can be released at the location "Prison", they will join the player).
- Added random cars that can be found in the raid (Sedan, Van, Taxi, Police, Pickup, HMMWV)
- Added new music from Ficus Pro Sound Studios Barcelona.
- Added a system of dynamic music change, depending on the situation in the game (with a enemy attack).
- The storylines of Colonel Madson's Army and the Marauders have been completed. After the destruction of enemy bases, attacks on the player stop. You just have to live until spring.
- Fixed minor visual bugs at the starting location.
- Fixed loot at the starting location (Now you can find good loot in the later stages of the game).
- Fixed selection of resources in buildings (left mouse click did not work).
- Improved AI.

P. S .: Now that the main story has been almost completed, I'm starting to work on new scenarios for the game (Campaign for the US National Guard, Sandbox mode, Ironman mode). The new starting location is almost ready.

P. P. S .: Thank you for your understanding and trust. Leave review on Steam, it will be the best reward for me! :)

notes.title: BETA DEV BLOG VERSION 0.15.08
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36380161/18d104ce0663fae824ef2ac151a760a4ba357537.jpg[/img]

Hello friends!
The current update is the largest in the history of the game.

- Added cars with the ability to deploy people in them, shoot from them, crush enemies
- Added the ability to send vehicles with infantry to raids (significantly reduces travel time)
- Added new mechanic: production efficiency (for factories)
- Added a lot of new small arms (rifles, machine guns, machine guns, etc.)

- Added new researches:
* Heating stove (you can upgrade your buildings with heating stoves, only for a shack, greenhouse level 1, fort point 2 level, hospital)
* Improved machine tools (increases production efficiency by 25%)
* Production efficiency (increases base production efficiency up to 50%)
* Production efficiency II (increases production efficiency by 25%)
* Vaccine against the virus (you can heal infected people in the hospital)
* New small arms (rifles, machine guns, machine guns, etc.)

- Added night effects for the prison
- Increased starting number of soldiers

- Fixed and improved starting location
- Fixed the prison, now the guard takes a position on the tower
- Fixed AI, soldiers return to their positions after rearmament, treatment, etc.)
- Fixed wild animals (only goats were created)
- Fixed difficulty settings for the number of zombies
- Fixed cursor when hovering over an enemy in a building
- Fixed critical bugs that break the game (the attack of looters and wandering gangs was carried out not on the player, but on the mall)
- Fixed efficiency of the church (x4 times increase in stability, if there is a ministry)
- Fixed shack (now 2 floors, accommodates 10 people, has the ability to install a heating stove)
- Fixed automatic reloading of weapons for soldiers
- Fixed shooting (through small objects)
- Fixed research branch
- Fixed greenhouses (they kept working at extremely low temperatures)
- Fixed situations for resource exploration, increased the number of found resources x2 times (fuel and food)
- Fixed and improved mechanics of revolution in the settlement (more massive and armed uprising)
- Fixed wandering gangs, they move towards the camp in case of joining / attacking
- Fixed the player's camera (the player did not open the map at -10 degrees)

In the next updates:

The "Torture" system, new locations for this mechanic (Raids), the main bases of enemies (marauders and the troops of Colonel Madson), after clearing the enemy base, enemy attacks will stop.
New starting locations, new game scenarios (campaign for the US Army). New transport (trucks, with the ability to fire (6 shooters), Hummer.
Heavy stationary machine guns, their installation on cars and buildings.
New enemy types (Colonel Madson's Guard)

Now there is no localization of everything new in the game, I will fix it in the near future!

P. S .: It took a lot of time to implement cars (AI, mechanics, destruction system, etc.), to test, find errors, fix and much more, there is still a lot of work ahead! Thank you for your support, for helping with development, I really appreciate it. Leave reviews about the game in Steam, for me this is the best reward!
